title: Reserve step 6 — the settlement precondition: 600,000 CRC of tCeBM held
description: The payer bank's tCeBM balance is non-zero and covers the max_amount_in it is about to commit. This is the pre-condition half of the settlement assertion.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. No identity parameter is accepted — a bank can only read its own balance. The post-condition is in mocks/amm/residue, where the payer's net debit is shown to be amount_in rather than max_amount_in.
